verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a Git hosting platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Gitea shipping an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server (gitea-mcp) lets external agents connect to Gitea, which is an adjacent integration rather than a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
